title: Warm Crunchy Chinese Chicken Toast
description: A sweet and crunchy Chinese dish featuring basil leaves and toast, perfect for a solo dinner, originating from the Chaozhou cuisine, and is low-fat-friendly, served in an individual mini cocotte.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, salt, and black pepper to make the sauce.
In a separate bowl, toss the chicken pieces with the sauce until they are well coated.
Heat the olive oil in a small skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken until it is browned and cooked through.
Toast the bread slices until they are lightly browned and crispy.
In a small bowl, mix together the chopped basil leaves and scallions.

To assemble the dish, place a toasted bread slice in the bottom of an individual mini cocotte, followed by a few pieces of the cooked chicken, and finally a spoonful of the basil and scallion mixture.
Drizzle any remaining sauce over the top of the dish and serve warm.
Garnish with additional basil leaves and scallions if desired.
